items.text: Patriots downgrade WR A.J. Brown to OUT for Sunday vs Dolphins (knee/ankle).
items.why: Official downgrade after limited/missed practices; knee flare-up.
items.implication: Removes high-upside WR; opens targets for Diggs/others in NE offense.
items.opportunity: Increased target share for remaining Patriots pass-catchers.

items.text: Patriots rule RB TreVeyon Henderson OUT vs Dolphins (illness).
items.why: Missed practices Thursday/Friday with illness; official OUT.
items.implication: Removes handcuff/insurance RB; boosts Rhamondre Stevenson volume.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed IN / expected to play vs Bills after full practices, no designation; small docks on rushing.
items.why: Full participant, not on final report; still feels some pain but bearable.
items.implication: Major unlock for Ravens offense and Zay Flowers.
items.opportunity: Full QB1 upside with possible reduced rush volume.

items.text: RJ Harvey (knee) OUT; unique role means no clean replacement but 3-6 more targets available in Broncos offense; Waddle also Q.
items.why: Knee injury; ETR board lists OUT.
items.implication: Target bump for Waddle (if plays) and other Broncos pass-catchers; backfield to Coleman/Dobbins.

items.text: Breece Hall (quad) Q again with cryptic tweet and trade rumors; thought close last week.
items.why: Limited practices; cryptic social post amid trade talk.
items.implication: Monitor inactives; Braelon Allen ready if OUT.
items.opportunity: Allen lead back if Hall sits.

items.text: Saquon Barkley IN / no designation despite hamstring/back; shocked not on report but playing (likely limited).
items.why: Cleared after missing some practices; played limited snaps prior week.
items.implication: RB1 volume expected but re-injury risk and possible snap limit.
items.conflict: Berry hates due to usage concerns.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT; Saquon IN.
items.why: Smith hamstring, Wicks ankle; board lists OUT.
items.implication: Higher target share for Goedert/others with Barkley back.

items.text: Emeka Egbuka (concussion, foot) taken OUT in projections; fallout visible in updated projs.
items.why: Concussion and foot issues; ETR removed from projs.
items.implication: Opens Bucs WR targets; monitor Godwin/others.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining TB WRs.

items.text: Josh Jacobs going Ashton Jeanty route: high-value touches king; 3 carries inside-5 and 13 targets in two games since suspension.
items.why: Goal-line and target volume driving fantasy value despite efficiency.
items.implication: Strong RB start with CAR matchup; sell-high risk if volume fades.

items.text: Zay Flowers LOVE/WR5: Lamar expected back unlocks him in track-meet Bills-Ravens.
Colston Loveland 30% target share and 19.2 PPG / top-5 TE finishes in 2 games since Caleb Williams return; leads utilization.
items.why: Sustained high target share post-Williams return.

items.text: Carnell Tate (shoulder) OUT per Sunday injury board.
items.implication: Titans WR depth thinned; monitor other TEN pass-catchers.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle HATE: production lacking; Chiefs allow just 1 WR TD all year (to JSN).
items.why: Tough KC secondary + poor recent production; also Q with chest.
items.conflict: Possible target bump if Harvey OUT.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins role hit: season-low snaps/targets with Dylan Sampson back; prior 13.6% target share without him. Sell-high per Levitan after 2-TD game.
items.why: Sampson return cuts passing-game role significantly.
items.implication: Still lead touches but lower ceiling; sell-high candidate.
